segments.he: סיפרו לפני רבינו ז"ל שהרב הצדיק מוואלטישסקאל (שהי' מחותנו של רבינו ז"ל) שאמר שארבעים שנה כבר כוסף ומשתוקק לעלות לא"י ואמר הרה"צ מחוועלניק ז"ל (שהי' ג"כ מחותנו של רבינו ז"ל) למה צריכים כ"כ לכסוף אם רוצים ליסע רק פותחים (הקאסע) התיבה שמונה המעות, ולוקחים מעות ונוסעים. ואמר רבינו ז"ל שזה יסע ויבא לא"י וזה לא כי העיקר הוא הרצון והכיסופין.
segments.en: Elders of our fellowship who knew my grandfather Reb Shmuel the Alef — who was close to Rabbainu's Chassidus and kept Rabbainu's sister Perel in his home. The story that happened [which I also heard from my family]: once he did not know the explanation of a passage in the writings of the Ari — and he asked that the Ari come and tell him the explanation. And so it was — the Ari came to him and told him the explanation. But he sensed that the Ari was displeased at having been troubled. And so he went every Friday to the Ari's grave and said all of Tehillim to appease him — and this was a great burden for him, for he was the Mara d'Asra [city rabbi] and had no time. Yet despite this he fulfilled it. When Moharan'as came to Eretz Yisroel and was at Reb Shmuel the Alef's home, he explained to him the greatness of the ten chapters of Tehillim [the Tikun HaKlali] — and from then on, when he went to the Ari's grave, he recited those ten chapters. For he said: these ten chapters encompass all of Tehillim in their entirety. And Reb Shmuel the Alef had all of Rabbainu's holy books and would study in them.
